title: Invoicing and Credit Terms by Tier: Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
Credit control holds six figures for each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes: how long the company has to pay, what an overdue balance costs each month, how large an unpaid balance the programme may carry, whether bookings are billed on one consolidated invoice, how long a line may be disputed after the invoice date, and what is added when the company elects to be invoiced in another currency.

| Programme tier | Payment terms (days from the invoice date) | Monthly interest on an overdue balance (per cent) | Credit limit (USD) | Consolidated invoicing | Invoice dispute window (calendar days) | Currency conversion markup (per cent) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 0 | 1.5 | 2500.00 | No | 14 | 3.0 |
| Business Team Programme | 14 | 1.5 | 15000.00 | No | 21 | 2.5 |
| Business Pro Programme | 30 | 1.5 | 75000.00 | Yes | 30 | 2.0 |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 30 | 1.25 | 350000.00 | Yes | 45 | 1.5 |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 45 | 1.0 | 1250000.00 | Yes | 60 | 1.0 |
| Business Global Programme | 60 | 1.0 | 5000000.00 | Yes | 90 | 0.5 |

Column meanings, as the programme schedule defines them: payment terms are the days from the invoice date by which the company must pay; the interest figure is the monthly interest charged on an overdue balance, as a percentage; the credit limit is the largest unpaid balance the programme may carry before new bookings are held; consolidated invoicing states whether every booking is billed on one consolidated invoice rather than card by card; the dispute window is the calendar days after the invoice date within which a line may be disputed; the markup is the percentage added when the company elects to be invoiced in a currency other than the contract currency.

Two readings follow from the table alone. Payment terms of 0 days on the Business Starter Programme mean that tier's invoices carry no days of credit from the invoice date. And the two lowest tiers are the two that show No for consolidated invoicing, so on those tiers a booking is billed card by card.
